onboardingFlow.identityHint: Wonke umuntu wamukelekile. Lokhu kwenza indlela osebenzisa ngayo ifanele wena.
onboardingFlow.photoHint: Khetha isithombe ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukukubona.
onboardingFlow.bioHint: Yini ekwenza wehluke? Umphakathi ufuna ukukwazi.
onboardingFlow.bioPlaceholder: Sitshele ngezinto ozithandayo nalokho othanda ukwabelana ngakho…
onboardingFlow.profileHint: Masilungise iphrofayela yakho ukuze abantu bakuthole.
onboardingFlow.finishHint: Imininingwane yephrofayela yakho izogcinwa ukuze uqedele ukubhalisa emphakathini.
onboardingFlow.registerHint: Isinyathelo sokugcina! Bhalisa ukuze ujoyine umphakathi wakho.
onboardingFlow.invitePlaceholder: Ikhodi yesimemo selungu noma yokungena ye-MVP
onboardingFlow.inviteHint: Ukubhalisa kungesimemo. Uma uvule isixhumanisi sesimemo, ikhodi ivela lapha. Uma kungenjalo, cela ikhodi elungwini elikumemile.
onboardingFlow.name: Igama
onboardingFlow.resumed: Ukubhalisa kuqhubekile. Inqubekelaphambili igcinwe kulesi siphequluli.
onboardingFlow.missing: Gcwalisa ubulili, usuku lokuzalwa ne-Banda yakho ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
onboardingFlow.invalidInvite: Ikhodi yesimemo ayivumelekile noma ayitholakali. Yihlole bese uzama futhi.
onboardingFlow.confirmEmail: I-akhawunti idaliwe! Qinisekisa i-imeyili yakho bese ungena ukuze uqhubeke nokubhalisa. Inqubekelaphambili igcinwe kulesi siphequluli.
onboardingFlow.tourGroupsHint: Dala amaqembu, hlela imicimbi futhi wabelane nabangani bakho.
onboardingFlow.tourStoriesHint: Yabelana ngezikhathi zakho ezinhle kakhulu nomphakathi.
onboardingFlow.residenceHint: Khetha lapho uhlala khona, noma usohambweni noma emsebenzini.
onboardingFlow.atAddress: Ingabe usekhelini ofuna ukulixhumanisa ne-Banda yakho manje?
onboardingFlow.weakSignal: Isignali ibuthakathaka. Zama futhi noma uqinisekise kamuva.
onboardingFlow.locationCaptured: Indawo itholiwe. Ukunemba okubikwe yidivayisi: cishe amamitha angu-{{accuracy}}. Ukuqinisekiswa kwendawo yokuhlala kusalindile.
onboardingFlow.codeHint: Ikhodi ihlonza ikheli. Ilungelo lokulisebenzisa lizohlolwa ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwesitifiketi.
onboardingFlow.confirmLaterHint: Ungaqedela ukubhalisa futhi ubambe iqhaza. Qinisekisa ikheli kamuva kokuthi Iphrofayela → Qinisekisa i-Banda yami.
onboardingFlow.residenceNotice: Ukuba khona kwakho manje akufakazeli ukuhlala. Izinzuzo zendawo zidinga i-Banda eqinisekisiwe; ukuhamba akuyishintshi ngokuzenzakalelayo i-Banda yakho.

calls.addToCallDescription: Izingcingo zombili zabantu ngabanye zizophela. Kuzokwakhiwa iqembu elisha futhi bobathathu bazothola isimemo sengqungquthela yezwi. Umuntu ngamunye kufanele amukele. Imiyalezo nokuqoshiwe kwangaphambilini ngeke kwabelwane ngakho.
calls.conferenceInvited: Izimemo zithunyelwe. Thepha Yamukela ukuze ujoyine ingqungquthela.
calls.waitingDescription: Ucingo lwakho lwamanje luyaqhubeka. Ukuze uphendule lolu cingo, qeda olwamanje.

academiaPublic.title: Imiphakathi ye-Akhademi
academiaPublic.heroBody: Khetha umkhakha, thola inselelo futhi ufunde kubantu abanolwazi. Ungaqala ngento oyithandayo, ulungiselele umsebenzi noma uthuthukise ibhizinisi lakho.
academiaPublic.cohortsBody: Uhlelo olufanayo kubo bonke nokwelulekwa ngasese ngomsebenzi womuntu ngamunye. Ukujoyina kumahhala; hlola izinto ezidingekayo ngaphambi kokubamba iqhaza.
academiaPublic.noCohorts: Awekho amakilasi alokhu okukhethile okwamanje. Ungahlola omunye umkhakha noma uzibekele umgomo wakho.
academiaPublic.worksBody: Imisebenzi eqinisekisiwe futhi eshicilelwe ababambiqhaza ngokuzithandela.

beleza-moda.title: Ubuhle, imfashini nokubukeka
beleza-moda.description: Ukugunda, ukulungisa izinwele, ukuluka, izimonyo, ukuthunga nokwethula izinsizakalo.
beleza-moda.starter_instructions: Lungiselela ukwethulwa kwensizakalo yakho bese uchaza indlela obale ngayo intengo.

cozinha-negocios.title: Ukupheka namabhizinisi okudla
cozinha-negocios.description: Ukupheka, ukubhaka, ukuhlinzeka ngokudla emicimbini namabhizinisi amancane okudla.
cozinha-negocios.starter_instructions: Yethula umkhiqizo, izithako, izindleko nentengo oyiphakamisayo.

criacao-digital.title: Ukusungula nokuxhumana ngedijithali
criacao-digital.description: Izithombe, amavidiyo, ukuklama, izinkundla zokuxhumana namathuluzi edijithali.
criacao-digital.starter_instructions: Dala isithombe, iphosta noma ividiyo emfushane yokwethula ibhizinisi.

musica-expressao.title: Umculo, umdanso nokuziveza
musica-expressao.description: Umculo, ukukhiqiza, umsebenzi ka-DJ, umdanso, ukudlala nokuziveza ngobuciko.
musica-expressao.starter_instructions: Yethula into oyidalile noma umdlalo bese uchaza ofuna ukukuthuthukisa.

oficios-solucoes.title: Imisebenzi yezandla nezixazululo ezisebenzayo
oficios-solucoes.description: Ukulungisa, ukubaza, ubukhenikha, amandla neminye imisebenzi yezandla enokuqeqeshwa okuqondiswayo.
oficios-solucoes.starter_instructions: Ngokuqondiswa umeluleki, chaza inkinga bese ulungiselela isiphakamiso sensizakalo esifanele izinga lakho.

emprego-carreira.title: Ukuqashwa nokukhula emsebenzini
emprego-carreira.description: Ukulungiselela ukuqashwa, izilimi, ukubalwa kwezimali, ukuthuthwa kwempahla nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono omsebenzi.
emprego-carreira.starter_instructions: Lungisa i-CV nesethulo sakho ukuze kuhambisane nethuba elithile.
